pages.text: Mathematics can start almost at once. After $(thing)Number Systems$() the $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$() is made from quartz, iron, a comparator, a block of redstone and Quantum Dots, and it counts $(item)Natural Number Lattices$() from Cherenkov Quartz and redstone.
From lattices: $(item)Integer Rings$() with a redstone torch (a NOT gate: negation), and $(item)Rational Fields$() from rings with a comparator (which can subtract and compare: a quotient).

After $(thing)Formal Logic$() the $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$() is made from early parts too (books, a lattice, quartz, an Entangled Photon Pair, iron and a comparator). It writes $(item)Axiom Schemas$() from lattices, paper and a book, and makes $(item)Empty Sets$() from empty glass bottles: nothing, held in something.
Both are built on the Extreme Assembly Table, like all of the mod's crafting.
